title: payera decaryi
intro: Payera decaryi, commonly known as the Madagascar periwinkle, is a flowering plant native to the island of Madagascar. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Payera decaryi include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as vincristine and vinblastine, which have been isolated and used in the treatment of various cancers.
